numbers.table_value: These six-market daily-bar base rates include asset drift: in the audited November 2016 to November 2026 sample a zero-net-mean 2,000-draw 60-calendar-day block test produced 0.98 PAID_BOTH_HALVES rows out of 54 by chance on average (95% range 0 to 3), versus 5 observed. Choosing rows on the first five years and starting flat on the last five selected 3 rows: 2 stayed positive over 362 test trades at +0.100R per trade, a retrospective dependent sample at a uniform cost of 0.05 normal day with futures roll risk and D1 path uncertainty, not a prospective probability.

numbers.table_value: Daily bars; R is the stop distance; cost 0.05 of a normal day (D1 ATR14) per round trip; a decision at a close is entered at the next open; inside one bar the stop is taken before the target; one trade at a time per market and behaviour. t is the mean over its standard error using sample standard deviation (nominal IID, not a dependence-adjusted significance claim). Halves split at the fixed midpoint of the calendar window, not the median trade. BTC sessions include weekends; futures are unadjusted continuous proxies with roll risk. Signed oil prices are retained; pending entries use decision-close ATR and include the fill bar.
